description:
The Ultimate guide to Choosing the Best Health insurance plan in 2024

In this video, we’ll compare three popular health insurance plans: ICICI Lombard Elevate Plan, Niva Bupa ReAssure 2.0, and Star Health Super Star Plan. We’ll explore their key features, coverage limits, no-claim bonuses, waiting periods, and premium costs. By the end, you’ll have a clear understanding of the pros and cons of each plan to help you choose the best health insurance for your needs.

0:00 Introduction
2:00 Claim settlement ratio, Incurred claim ratio, network hospitals, Claim process
4:55 Key features, ELEVATE, REASSURE 2.O AND STAR SUPER STAR
8:33 SUM ASSURED, ENTRY AGE, VARIANTS, POLICY TENURE, ROOM RENT
9:47 ICU,ICCU PRE AND POST, DAY CARE, MODERN TREATMENTS, E CONSULTATION
10:35 RESTORATION, AMBULANCE, AIR AMBULANCE, NO CLAIM BONUS, HOME CARE TREATMENTS. PED WAITING PERIODS
12:01 ANNUAL HEALTH CHECK UP, AYUSH TREATMENTS, CONSUMABLES, WELLNESS PROGRAM
13:05 DEDUCTIBLES
13:30 MATERNITY COVER, NEW BORN BABY COVER 
14:40 PREMIUMS COMPARISON
